tasks.commitBody:
The sign-in surface is fully localized: heading, all error branches
and the last-used marker on /auth/login resolve through Paraglide in
en/et/lv/uk. Provider display names now have exactly one source:
AUTH_PROVIDERS carries a Paraglide message reference per provider
(canonical order unchanged) and a shared providerLabel resolver; the
login page, invite landing, profile link-picker, linked-identity rows
and the signed-in-as banner all read from it. The profile page's
second hardcoded PROVIDER_LABELS map is deleted. Estonian eID product
names stay untranslated. No sign-in behaviour changes.

New keys login_heading, login_error_csrf_mismatch,
login_error_missing_session_token, login_error_generic,
login_last_used, auth_provider_* (6) in en/et/lv/uk.

Closes #218
